description: Test utility functions for verifying repository data, metadata, and LiveData handling in the org.fdroid.database package.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: Object containing test utility functions for repository and metadata validation, and LiveData handling.

methods.name: assertTimestampRecent
methods.description: Asserts that the given timestamp is recent (within 2000 milliseconds).

methods.name: assertRepoEquals
methods.description: Asserts that the given RepoV2 object matches the Repository object, comparing mirrors, anti-features, categories, release channels, and core repository data.

methods.name: App.toMetadataV2
methods.description: Extension function converting an App object to a MetadataV2 object.

methods.name: AppVersion.toPackageVersionV2
methods.description: Extension function converting an AppVersion object to a PackageVersionV2 object.

methods.name: LiveData.getOrAwaitValue
methods.description: Suspends and waits for LiveData to emit a value or times out after 2 seconds.

methods.name: LiveData.getOrFail
methods.description: Retrieves the value from LiveData or fails if no value is available.
